title: Rollout-Level Advantage-Prioritized Experience Replay for GRPO
abstract: arXiv:2606.04560v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards with GRPO is a standard approach for post-training reasoning LLMs. It remains sample inefficient. Each rollout is used for a single gradient update and then discarded. Naive replay is not well suited in this setting because LLM policies drift quickly per gradient step. Stored rollouts therefore become stale and can destabilize training. We propose a rollout-level replay buffer for GRPO that stores and samples individual rollouts rather than whole groups. The buffer bounds staleness through age eviction. Any rollout older than tau_max training steps is removed. The buffer also preserves on-policy data via fresh-anchored composition. Each batch keeps its fresh on-policy rollouts and then concatenates replay rollouts drawn separately from the buffer. We prioritize replay by per-rollout advantage magnitude and recycle individual rollouts whose advantages are large. Across three Qwen3-B

translated_title: 面向GRPO的Rollout级优势优先经验回放
translated_abstract: 结合GRPO的基于可验证奖励的强化学习是对推理型大语言模型进行后训练的标准方法，但其样本效率仍然低下：每次采样的rollout仅用于单次梯度更新后即被丢弃。朴素的经验回放并不适合该场景，因为LLM策略在每次梯度步中漂移迅速，存储的rollout因此会变得过时，并可能破坏训练稳定性。我们提出了一种面向GRPO的rollout级别回放缓冲区，它存储和采样的对象是单个rollout而非整个组。该缓冲区通过按年龄淘汰来限制数据过时程度，任何超过tau_max个训练步的rollout都会被移除。缓冲区还通过“新鲜锚定”的组合方式保留在策略数据：每个批次保留其新鲜的在策略rollout，再拼接从缓冲区中单独抽取的回放rollout。我们依据每个rollout的优势幅度对回放进行优先级排序，并回收优势较大的单个rollout。在三个Qwen3-B（原文截断）……的实验中……
tldr: 该论文提出一种面向GRPO的rollout级优势优先经验回放方法，通过按年龄淘汰限制数据过时、以新鲜在策略数据锚定训练稳定性，并优先回收高优势样本，从而提升推理大语言模型强化学习后训练的样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a rollout-level advantage-prioritized experience replay for GRPO that bounds rollout staleness via age eviction, preserves on-policy data through fresh-anchored batch composition, and recycles high-advantage rollouts, thereby improving sample efficiency in RL post-training of reasoning LLMs.
